about: Every floor with rows that the overnight sweep of every airport's live board recorded (2026-10-19, 1920x1080, build v24064): the view it was drawn in, its size, the moment and the board's languages; the page's places as this build reads them, in row order (code, lat, lon, zone, name, every language's name, flights, flown, next; the next flight is the one whose name the live board drew larger, a place is flown when every flight to it that is not cancelled had gone): the coded rows as recorded, then the rows with no code that the map now reads (the sweep kept no row order for those, so they come last), with this build's positions, zones and names; what main's layout named on main's own page, measured with the board's font, and which of those names were in a conflict (by another place's dot or arrow, a line through a name, two names touching). The font: the board's, as the floor measures it. tests/earth-floor-sweep.test.js

font.about: Bricolage Grotesque (fids-current/fonts/bricolage, the board's font) at weight 700, width 100, optical size = the pixel size, as the floor draws its names: each character's advance and each pair's kerning in units of 1/1000 em, read from the repo's woff2 subsets with fontTools; the floor's textW adds 0.01 em a letter and 0.2 em. Chrome's canvas measureText agrees within 0.15 px.
